---
title: "Super Lig xG Analysis"
---

## Project Overview

This project analyzes the relationship between expected goals and match performance indicators in the Turkish Süper Lig.

Our main focus is to understand how xG is related to goals scored, goals conceded, shots on target, and points per game.

## Team Members

-   Necati Berkay Vural
-   Ömer Faruk Okur
-   Ulaş Utku Bedel

## Key Takeaways

-   Expected Goals is a useful metric for measuring the quality of chances created by teams.

-   xG is positively related to actual goals scored, but the relationship is not perfect.

-   xGA is useful for evaluating defensive performance because it is related to goals conceded.

-   

    ## Differences between xG and actual goals can be explained by finishing quality, goalkeeper performance, tactical factors, and randomness.
